title: Each change records its stage times and cost
what: Every change keeps its stage times, cost and coverage.
why: The owner wants to see what a change costs.

question: **1. Should work that never lands get its own record?**
A change record is written at a landing. A design that is never built has none, so its cost is not counted anywhere.
| | a. record at the run's end | b. ledger view only |
| cost | 1 record per run | none |
options: a. A record at the run's end (recommended; rests on the measured 31.9%).
reading: Front's reading: a record of kind design, analysis or experiment at the run's end.

question: **2. Must the front label a design's cost as an estimate?**
Today a design's cost is shown as a plain number.
